draftNote: 2 of five queued off a bottom-two lane: Mr_Meat31 (support→offlane), Xeebs (carry→jungle).

coaching.headline: The map finished 2-9 in towers — they cashed four of their five won fights into objectives and we cashed none.
coaching.team: We drafted two unfavored solo lanes into Skylar and Greystone and fed them to 12/0 and 5/0 while the favored jungle won its duels all game. The film flags two of us with no armor against a three-physical comp whose main damage was Greystone's 31k. Fight selection was the bigger leak: the 11.7 and 16.8 losses were taken with teammates alive elsewhere on the map, and the 22.5 fight in our half was a bad trade — 0-3 with no prize up. Objective damage told the story: 13788 from us against 54832 from them.
coaching.whatShiftedIt: The 22.5-to-25 stretch decided it — back-to-back 0-3 fights in our half and at their inner tower, then Orb Prime and the Genesis Core went over at 25-26 and the base was open.

perPlayer.7c8ab99c-31c5-4ea5-a6fa-e0d6417c3f1b: Mr_Meat31 led the team in vision with 13 wards but finished 0/5/0, giving first blood at 2.9 and getting caught alone by Yin at 20.5. The film's repeated note is rotation: at 22.5 and 23.8 he was alive and ahead in lane while the team fought and lost 0-3 — shoving the wave and arriving flips those numbers.
perPlayer.10edbf65-457d-48d0-9151-9df5b4fcb40a: Willy Guggenheim won the jungle outright on Shinbi — Yin died to the wolves at 2.9, 6.9 and 18 — and the Fangtooth taken at 12 turned the lost 11.7 fight into a trade. But he mitigated 35406, the most on the team, with no armor into a three-physical enemy comp, and the 22.6, 23.8 and 27.1 deaths all came in fights the team started without full numbers.
perPlayer.a412baf3-dd17-4f89-8ecf-9d0704f3a79e: Xeebs' lane was read 'ours early, theirs late' into Skylar and it played out exactly that way: 1/6 with 8601 hero damage and zero objective damage, and the 22.5 and 23.8 deaths were the expensive kind — both inner towers and Orb Prime followed them. The build skipped Solaris and Nuclear Rounds from Eden's meta core, so the power to stand up to a 12/0 Skylar never came online.

threats: Chain-CC risk (1 hard-CC abilities, ~0.5s of lockdown): Iggy & Scorch Inferno (knockback). Don't group tight into it — stagger the engage and hold mobility/cleanse for the key one.
synergy: Our engage/CC: Grux Crush (knockup 0.5s). Our kills come from landing burst INSIDE that CC window — whoever lands it, the rest must follow up immediately.
Strong AoE/teamfight kit — group at choke points and fight on top of objectives.

ourKits.combo: Smash 'n Grab pull → Crush knockup → Warlord's Challenge stun → bleed-stacked basics
ourKits.winCondition: land the pull→knockup chain to lock a target while bleed and AS shred them
ourKits.passive: basics stack a bleed for sustained damage
ourKits.playWith: follow-up burst inside his knockup/stun window
ourKits.playAgainst: telegraphed engage — bait Crush/Pull, then punish; kite his slow start

ourKits.combo: Mark a target → Hive slow → Swarm reposition → Curse execute-burst ult
ourKits.winCondition: Mark + Curse a squishy and delete them with %max-HP Pestilence
ourKits.playWith: setup that holds her marked target
ourKits.playAgainst: she's squishy with one escape (Swarm) — dive after it's used; spread vs Hive

ourKits.combo: Dread Nova stun → Ether Crystal push/lift → Particle Shredder channel → Synaptic Obliterator beams
ourKits.winCondition: poke from max range and zone with the crystal
ourKits.playWith: a frontline to protect his stationary channel
ourKits.playAgainst: dodge Dread Nova; dive him during the immobile ult channel

ourKits.combo: Rushing Beat dashes → Line Tempo wolves → Circle Rhythm shield → All-Kill! wolfpack ult
ourKits.winCondition: stack Track and unleash All-Kill! in a grouped fight
ourKits.playAgainst: spread vs the wolfpack; she's squishy without her shield up

ourKits.combo: stance-swap with Zero Shift → Tachyon Lance (ranged) or melee chain → Limit Break on Overheat
ourKits.winCondition: build Heat and burst with Limit Break, flexing range and melee
ourKits.passive: damage builds Heat → Overheat unlocks Limit Break
ourKits.playWith: peel that lets her ramp Heat safely
ourKits.playAgainst: pressure her before Overheat; CC during the melee stance

enemyKits.combo: Plasma Grenade → Hypercharge on-hit → Air Assault reposition → Atomiser ult
enemyKits.winCondition: Hypercharge and kite-shoot from Air Assault safety
enemyKits.passive: extra jump; kills cause corpse explosions
enemyKits.playWith: a frontline so she can free-fire airborne
enemyKits.playAgainst: CC her out of Air Assault; she's squishy on the ground

enemyKits.combo: Oil Spill → Molotov ignite → Flame Turret → Inferno knockback ult
enemyKits.winCondition: layer fire zones on a choke/objective and burn the team
enemyKits.playWith: CC that holds enemies in his fire
enemyKits.playAgainst: don't fight in his zones — flank; kill the turret, dive him

enemyKits.combo: Lash Kick gap-close+slow → Windburn %hp basics → Backlash push, Quelling Gale to disengage

enemyKits.playWith: a team that lets her side-lane and pick
enemyKits.playAgainst: she wants 1v1s — group and burst her; Quelling Gale only stops projectiles

enemyKits.combo: Assault The Gates leap → Make Way armor shred → Sacred Oath empowered basic → Stone Forged Soul stasis ult
enemyKits.winCondition: front-line aggressively and reset the fight with the stasis heal
enemyKits.playWith: a team that fights while he soaks and stasis-resets
enemyKits.playAgainst: don't waste burst into his stasis — wait it out; anti-heal cuts the ult heal

enemyKits.combo: Stasis Bomb stun → Photon Disruptor slow → Containment Fence wall → Ion Strike slow ult
enemyKits.winCondition: lock a target with stun + fence and let the team collapse

skylar.loadout: Weald (Forage + Wind-Rider), augment Assault MK-II , crest Exodus
lines: Lead story: Hard to kill. Never died in 28 minutes, fewer deaths than about 95% of Skylar carry players this patch. The build added healing off damage.
Skylar dealt 29,036 hero damage, 27% of their team's, with +192 physical power from items.

Penetration: Vanquisher 12; against Eden (level 13: about 86 physical armor, 74 after penetration; took 11,399 physical damage from heroes, 73% of all hero damage they took) and Morigesh (level 15: about 88 physical armor, 76 after penetration; took 10,049 physical damage from heroes, 41% of all hero damage they took) that is about 7% and 7% more damage (estimate: percent penetration taken before flat).
Tainted Rounds (item): On Successful Basic Attacks: Reduce the Target's Healing by 45% for 3s. Deal (+10%) (+20%) Damage On-Hit. Increases by up to 100% as the Target's Health decreases.
Exodus (crest): Lob a grenade that pierces Enemy Units. Explodes upon hitting Terrain. Deals 90 (+80%) Damage and Stuns for 0.1s. Launches Back Enemy Heroes.
Weald (Eternal): Damaging an Enemy Hero below 30% Health fires 4 (+1 per 30% Bonus Attack Speed) projectiles that each deal 7 (+1 per level) True Damage.

Sustain: 22% lifesteal; Tainted Rounds: On Successful Basic Attacks: Reduce the Target's Healing by 45% for 3s. Deal (+10%) (+20%) Damage On-Hit. Increases by up to 100% as the Target's Health decreases.; Terminus: On Overhealing from Lifesteal: Convert excess Healing into a Shield. Max Shield size: (+100%). The Shield slowly decays 15s after leaving combat.; 2,589 healing recorded.
Stack (Every basic attack set off): 3 effects on one trigger: Plasma Blade, Tainted Rounds, Weald.
Stack (Healing off the damage): 3 effects on one trigger: Tainted Rounds, Terminus, Exodus.
Stack (Finishing damage on low-health targets): 2 effects on one trigger: Vanquisher, Weald. Once a fight started going their way, these finished it.
The Eternal was part of it: Weald (Forage + Wind-Rider) sits on the same triggers as the items (every basic attack set off; finishing damage on low-health targets), so the same hits paid out twice.
Countered? 1 of the 4 players Skylar killed built physical armor (Argus). Anti-heal on Grux. We killed Skylar 0 times.

Copy it? Weald (Forage + Wind-Rider): 50.7% in 633 Skylar carry games, above the hero's 47.1%; this 3-item core: 50.9% in 281 games, level with the 50.2% of that hero-role's cores. Proven this patch: worth copying.

greystone.loadout: Thraex (Savage Strikes + Ferocity), augment Close Cut, crest Judgement
lines: Lead story: Hard to kill. Never died in 28 minutes, fewer deaths than about 95% of Greystone offlane players this patch. The build added health and armor and healing off damage.
Their build heals off damage: anti-heal (the Tainted items) cuts it.
Greystone dealt 30,833 hero damage, 29% of their team's, with +122 physical power from items.
Tainted Rounds (item): On Successful Basic Attacks: Reduce the Target's Healing by 45% for 3s. Deal (+10%) (+20%) Damage On-Hit. Increases by up to 100% as the Target's Health decreases.
Overlord (item): On Successful Basic Attack: Deal (+1%) Damage. Deal (+30%) (+2.5%) Damage around the Target. Damage decreases from 100% to 50% based on distance.
Judgement (crest): Deal 70 (+40%) Damage in an area around you. On Hero hit, Heal (+30%) (+8%). Subsequent Hero hits Heal for 50% effectiveness.

Thraex (Eternal): Mark the last Enemy Hero damaged by your Basic Attack for 3s, increasing your damage against them by 3% (+0.4% per level) and reducing the damage they deal to you by 1.5% (+0.35% per level).
Close Cut (augment): Make Way deals 20% increased damage to the nearest Enemy Unit.

Increases by up to 100% as the Target's Health decreases.; Judgement: Deal 70 (+40%) Damage in an area around you. On Hero hit, Heal (+30%) (+8%). Subsequent Hero hits Heal for 50% effectiveness.; Savage Strikes: Deal 1.5 (+0.4 per level) Physical Damage On-Hit. Attacking an Enemy Hero increases this by 100% for 3s, stacking up to 3 times. Heal for the damage dealt.; 13,925 healing recorded.
Toughness: +950 health, +60 magical armor; took 38,499 damage, mitigated 34,672, died 0 times.
Stack (Every basic attack set off): 4 effects on one trigger: Tainted Rounds, Overlord, Thraex, Savage Strikes.
Stack (Healing off the damage): 3 effects on one trigger: Tainted Rounds, Judgement, Savage Strikes.

Countered? 0 of the 4 players Greystone killed built physical armor. Anti-heal on Grux. We killed Greystone 0 times.
Copy it? Thraex (Savage Strikes + Ferocity): 50.3% in 2,224 Greystone offlane games, below the hero's 51.9%. It wins less than usual elsewhere: it beat us, not the field.

lines: Lead story: Hard to kill. Never died in 28 minutes, fewer deaths than about 95% of Dekker support players this patch. The build added health and armor and healing off damage.
Ion Strike at rank 2: 95s base, about 63.3s by the end (33% shorter) from 50 ability haste: Enra's Blessing 15, Tainted Scepter 10, Dynamo 10, ultimate haste 15.
13 takedowns (1 kills, 12 assists) fed: Tainted Scepter (Malice).
Dekker dealt 11,324 hero damage, 11% of their team's, with +115 magical power from items.
Tainted Scepter (item): On Dealing Magical Damage: Reduce the Target's Healing by 45% for 4s.
Tainted Scepter (item): Once every second: Gain a stack of Malice. Stacks up to 15 times. Takedowns grant 15 stacks instantly. Hitting a Hero with Ability Damage will deal 1.5 (+1%) Damage per stack.
Dynamo (item): On Immobilizing an Enemy: They take 8% more damage for 2.5s.

Sustain: Enra's Blessing: When within 1000u of an Ally Hero, if they are Immobilized: Grant them a 50 (+30%)(+8%) Shield for 3.5s. Cooldown is per Target.; Tainted Scepter: On Dealing Magical Damage: Reduce the Target's Healing by 45% for 4s.; Sanctification: Grants yourself and nearby Heroes a 150 (+8%) Shield for 3s. While the Shield holds, Heroes gain 50% Tenacity.; 2,722 healing recorded.
Toughness: +845 health, +30 physical armor; took 14,085 damage, mitigated 12,608, died 0 times.
Countered? 1 of the 1 players Dekker killed built magical armor (Argus). We killed Dekker 0 times.
Copy it? Knell: 44.7% in 114 Dekker support games, below the hero's 48.9%. It wins less than usual elsewhere: it beat us, not the field.

card.lesson: Ion Strike came back about every 63s instead of 95s by the end (33% shorter). Count it, and take fights while it is down.
